correctness.rationale: For G=(C_p)^r, Burnside lemma gives each M_H from F_0 and line marks F_L; conversely M_0 and M_L recover them, with independent mark rows. Orbit-size marginals are A_j=sum_{dimK=j}x_K. On the kernel each A_j (j>=2) vanishes. Each line coordinate is forced as x_L=-sum_{K>=L,dimK>=2}p^(1-dimK)x_K, and the total-cardinality mark forces x_0=0. Remaining parameters have one zero-sum constraint in each dimension >=2, giving nullity sum_{j=2}^r([r choose j]_p-1), image rank (p^r-1)/(p-1)+r. For U,W j-spaces, the integer relation p^(j-1)([G/U]-[G/W])-sum_{L<=U}[G/L]+sum_{L<=W}[G/L] cancels all line and size marks and has distinct leading nonreference coefficients, so these form rational kernel basis. Independent exact rank computation for (C2)^3 produced 16 subgroups, rank10, nullity6 and a zero-mark witness. This is not an integral Smith-basis claim.
residual_risks: Only rational kernel basis; not saturated integral kernel basis or witness minimum
Finite rank check is illustrative only
